dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Aha, we meet again! Welcome to the Collective of Plenty, my friend!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: How's everything been going? Still as happy and well-fed as always?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Now that you're here, it's time to sit back and enjoy a bit of signature Collective of Plenty-style hospitality! C'mon, make yourself at home!
